1.consolidated_definition: Aficionarse de forma temporal y desmedida a una cosa o a una actividad. No es lo mismo de antes, pero se sigue vendiendo, los fanáticos reales compran rápido, hay quienes esperan a ahorrar para comprar, están los que ven la promo y se enfiebran y los que van a última hora.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To become temporarily and excessively enamored with something or an activity. It is not the same as before, but it continues to be sold; true fans buy quickly, there are those who wait to save up to purchase, there are those who see the promotion and get caught up in the excitement, and those who go at the last minute.
